draft_en.subject: From local-market converters to direct import - the first mixed carton
draft_en.body:
Hi Jayesh,

You mentioned moving from local-market media converters to importing directly. The gigabit converter for a first mixed carton: industrial Gigabit, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (or fixed SC 20 km), DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS (BIS stays on your side) - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 10G media converter we discussed is quoted separately once I know the quantity.

One question: for a first mixed carton of gigabit and 10G converters, what quantity per model would make the freight worthwhile for you?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
